abstract: Ultrasonograms of 45 patients with 51 surgically proved benign cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) of the ovary were reviewed to evaluate the ultrasonographic appearance of this entity. Contrary to several recent reports stressing a "typical" appearance for ovarian dermoid cysts, ie, an echogenic focus with acoustic shadowing situated within a predominantly cystic mass, the authors observed a much broader spectrum of appearances. Thirty-three percent of the cases demonstrated "typical" findings, 23.5% were predominantly solid, 20% were almost entirely cystic, and 23.5% were not visible. Ultrasound and conventional radiography in patients with dermoid cysts were compared: Ultrasonography contributed significantly to the correct diagnosis in the majority of cases. Because ultrasonography lacks ionizing radiation, and its use may reveal unrelated pelvic pathology, it should be the initial diagnostic modality in the examination of patients with suspected dermoid cysts of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 外科的に病理学的に証明された良性嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)51例を有する45例の超音波像を検討し、卵巣類皮嚢腫の超音波所見を評価した。卵巣類皮嚢腫は「典型的」な像、すなわち嚢胞性腫瘤内の輝度の高い焦点と音響陰影を特徴とするとされるが、近年の複数の報告とは異なり、より広いスペクトラムの像が認められた。典型的な所見は33%、ほぼ充実性は23.5%、ほぼ全体が嚢胞性は20%、描出されなかったものは23.5%であった。超音波検査とX線撮影を比較したところ、超音波検査は多くの症例で正しい診断に大きく寄与した。超音波検査は電離放射線を用いず、また無関係な骨盤内病変を明らかにしうるため、卵巣類皮嚢腫が疑われる患者の検査の第一選択とすべきである。
